articles.title: Magnitude 7.8 earthquake strikes coastal Ardin; hundreds reported dead
articles.summary: The government declared a national emergency after widespread building collapses, hospital damage and disrupted communications.

articles.title: International rescue teams deploy after Ardin earthquake
articles.summary: Emergency agencies said the confirmed death toll was rising and several coastal cities remained without power or clean water.

articles.title: Beloria and Carden sign immediate ceasefire after six weeks of fighting
articles.summary: The agreement halts cross-border attacks, opens humanitarian corridors and begins monitored troop withdrawals at midnight.

articles.title: Displaced residents begin returning after Beloria-Carden ceasefire
articles.summary: Aid groups said the truce could restore access to communities cut off during the conflict, though implementation risks remain.

articles.title: Demeria approves interim government after president resigns
articles.summary: Parliament backed a constitutional transfer of power and scheduled an early national election following weeks of mass protests.

articles.title: Grid failure leaves 40 million people without power across Estara
articles.summary: The outage halted rail networks, disrupted water systems and forced hospitals onto backup generation while authorities investigated the cause.

articles.title: Leading chipmaker reports record quarterly revenue on data-center demand
articles.summary: Revenue exceeded forecasts and the company raised its outlook, while warning that advanced packaging capacity remained constrained.

articles.title: Signal fault delays one regional rail line during evening commute
articles.summary: Service returned to normal after 45 minutes and no injuries were reported.

articles.title: Television actor announces opening date for new restaurant
articles.summary: The restaurant will begin taking reservations next month and released photographs of its menu.

articles.title: Phone maker releases seasonal wallpaper and icon theme
articles.summary: The optional download adds new colors and animated lock-screen images but does not change device functionality.
